verdict.rationale: HelixDB Cloud docs describe RBAC with scoped API keys (read-only, read-write, operation-restricted) and Bearer-token auth for least-privilege credentials, which covers API-key and role-based control. However, per-collection permission granularity is not evidenced — multi-tenancy docs explicitly push isolation to the application layer with 'no structural constraints on the database,' suggesting collection-level enforcement isn't a built-in DB feature. Missing for 10: explicit per-collection/per-resource permission scoping, independent/hands-on confirmation of RBAC enforcement in practice.
